scenarios.statement: Export writes a header row id,title,body, then one comma-separated line per note.
Export writes every note in the store; none is dropped.
Export of an empty store exits with 0 and writes only the header.
Export writes one JSON object per line and no header.
The Case that checks the header row stays green after the change.
All three current Cases are green, so the new export is reached.
Both exports run on the same store give the same set of notes, and the header Case is recorded as superseded.
Drop the Case that no note is dropped, because the old export is being replaced.

decompositions.statement: Replace the comma-separated export of the notes tool by JSON Lines, keeping that no note is dropped.

Replace the comma-separated export by JSON Lines. Then retire the comma-separated reader that an outside consumer still depends on, once that consumer reads JSON Lines. Then remove the transition option that served both.
